key.answer_key: No. Panel F6c, the region where a Ce mixed-valence signal is expected, is noise with no resolved peaks at the marked positions, and in panel F6d the fitted envelope for the Er signal sits well above the noisy underlying data, so the fit is not supported by the actual signal (o21).
